name: ☠️ Survive and kill The killers in The Area 51 🔪!
desc:
🎯Special Reward Code: 1489🎯
🔔 New Update 🔔

Added new decorations, bug fixes, and a brand-new map!

Can you survive the Scary Elevator?

Game Modes:
Survival ☠️: In Survival mode, your goal is to endure through different floors, each filled with terrifying monsters trying to catch you.

Combat 💥☠️: In Combat mode, you must escape and defeat the Creepypastas.

💡 Earn points by surviving on each floor or by collecting coins scattered around the map! 💡

🛗 Floors 🛗:
This game features over 50 different floors, including CHUCKY, GUEST666, GRIMACE, CLOWN, SLENDERMAN, AYUWOKI, GARFIELD, FNAF, SPONGEBOB, MOMO, and many more!
